title: Smart Mushroom Farming Workshop for Youth
description: A practical workshop introducing young innovators and students to smart mushroom farming, IoT technologies, AI-powered monitoring systems, and sustainable agribusiness opportunities.
location: JKUAT Smart Farm Zone, Juja, Kenya
agenda: Welcome • Introduction to Smart Mushroom Farming • IoT Demonstration • Hands-on Mushroom Bag Preparation • AI Dashboard Demonstration • Networking & Q&A
speakers: Dr. Peter Ochieng (WP5 Lead), Eng. Brian Mwangi (IoT Engineer), BRIDGE-AI Kenya Technical Team
